name: Geography
description: Countries, capitals, rivers, mountains and where things are on the map.

lessons.title: Great Rivers of the World
lessons.body:
Rivers are favorite quiz bowl subjects because questions can name the cities and countries they pass through.

| River | Continent | Remember |
|---|---|---|
| **Nile** | Africa | Usually called the longest river; flows north into the Mediterranean |
| **Amazon** | South America | Carries the most water of any river |
| **Yangtze** | Asia | Longest in Asia; the Three Gorges Dam is on it |
| **Mississippi** | North America | Ends in the Gulf of Mexico near New Orleans |
| **Danube** | Europe | Flows through four capitals: Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest, Belgrade |

**Tip:** when a question names a delta, dam or capital city, ask “which river runs there?”
keyFacts: The Nile flows north into the Mediterranean Sea.
The Amazon carries more water than any other river.
The Three Gorges Dam is on the Yangtze.
The Danube flows through Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade.
The Mississippi empties into the Gulf of Mexico.

lessons.title: Tricky World Capitals
lessons.body:
Many capitals are **not** the country’s biggest or most famous city. These come up often:

- **Australia:** Canberra (not Sydney)
- **Canada:** Ottawa (not Toronto)
- **Brazil:** Brasília (not Rio de Janeiro), a planned city built in the 1950s
- **Turkey:** Ankara (not Istanbul)
- **Switzerland:** Bern (not Zurich or Geneva)
- **Nigeria:** Abuja (not Lagos)
- **Pakistan:** Islamabad (not Karachi)

**South Africa** has three capitals: Pretoria (executive), Cape Town (legislative) and Bloemfontein (judicial).
keyFacts: Canberra is the capital of Australia.
Ottawa is the capital of Canada.
Ankara, not Istanbul, is the capital of Turkey.
South Africa has three capital cities.

tossups.question: This river forms part of the border between Romania and Bulgaria. It flows through Vienna and Budapest before emptying into the Black Sea. For 10 points, name this second-longest river in Europe.

Lake Burley Griffin lies in the middle of this city, which was chosen as a compromise between two rivals. It is home to Parliament House, and it is located between Sydney and Melbourne. For 10 points, name this capital of Australia.

bonuses.leadin: Name these national capitals that are not their country’s largest city, for 10 points each.

parts.question: This city is the capital of Canada.
This planned city replaced Rio de Janeiro as Brazil’s capital in 1960.
This city replaced Istanbul as the capital of Turkey in 1923.
